payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the baseline models used in the context of a treebank for learner language, specifically focusing on POS tagging and parsing performance.

claims.text: The baseline models include a large scale treebank of learner language that is manually annotated for POS tags and universal dependencies.
The models benchmark automatic tagging and parsing, measuring the effect of grammatical errors on tagging and parsing quality.
The treebank supports empirical studies of learner syntax in NLP, corpus linguistics, and second language acquisition.
